title: UCC1-308. How to Sign with reservation of rights- Explained
summary: Promoter explains signing with UCC 1-308 or a boxed symbol to avoid contract liability, and claims banks sell your checks as securities.

assertions.quote: this is how you sign without liability
no contract exists outside of the four corners so if i sign something put a box around it that's the only contract that there is

verdicts.note: Any mark made with intent to sign binds the signer; the four-corners rule concerns evidence, not signatures.

verdicts.note: Checks stopped coming back because of image clearing under Check 21; they are not bundled into securities.
